_comment_usage: Load this configuration by running: mysql-mcp --config path/to/server-config-example.json. Config Priority: CLI Flags > Environment Variables > Config File > Defaults
_comment_priority: For database connections and OAuth settings, the entire array/object must come from a single source to prevent mixing environments (e.g. CLI databases will fully override FILE databases).
_comment_docker: Docker mapping requirements: set host to 0.0.0.0 and adjust allowedIoRoots to match mounted volumes.
_comment_transport: Defaults to stdio. Use http for docker-compose configurations.
_comment_stateless: MCP v2 stateless HTTP mode using NodeStreamableHTTPServerTransport over /mcp
_comment_cors: Defaults to permissive handling; custom origins are advanced preview logic.
_comment_databases: Only the first database in the array is currently connected/supported by the MySQL adapter.

pool._comment_acquireTimeout: recommended lower value for tight integration

_comment: Core server options (host, port, transport, stateless, enableHSTS, trustProxy, metricsExport, toolFilter, auditConfig, allowedIoRoots, databases, oauth) can be specified as camelCase properties in this file. Ecosystem and sidecar integrations (REDIS_URL, CODEMODE_ISOLATION, PROXYSQL_*, MYSQL_ROUTER_*, MYSQLSH_*, DD_*, OTEL_*) must be supplied as environment variables.
